notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
The luxury deck mixes card types (gear, mod, cargo, crew, job); card_type is the printed type.

Crew 'skills' are the skill boxes at the bottom of the card. Job skills are the skill line under 'Job'; 'NONE' is printed on Attend Statue Dedication (skills: []). No job skill is printed in italics here.
Cards with no patrol icon printed have bottom.patrol = null.

cards.name: Extravagant Wardrobe
text: While you have 2 or 3 {REP_POS} reputations, you have 1 additional fame.
While you have 4 {REP_POS} reputations, you have 2 additional fame.

cards.name: Chromium Hull
text: When you gain fame, gain 1 additional fame. When you lose a ship combat, discard this card.
A player in your space can fight a ship combat against you as their encounter.

cards.name: Gift for Jabba
text: When you become defeated, discard 1 of your crew.

cards.name: Stolen Jewels
abilities: Action: Choose another player in your space and discard this card. You both gain {CREDITS}7,000 and 1 fame.

cards.name: Sy Snootles
text: When you complete a job, you may reduce the job's credit reward to {CREDITS}0 to gain 1 additional fame.

cards.name: Proton Torpedoes
text: When you win a combat against a patrol that has a fame reward, gain 1 additional fame.

cards.name: Attend Statue Dedication
cards.flavor: Your biggest fans would like to erect a statue in your honor on their world. They have asked you to help fund the statue and to attend its dedication.
cards.destination: Any planet where you have {REP_POS} reputation with the planet's faction.
cards.reward: Gain 1 fame. You may spend {CREDITS}10,000 to gain 1 additional fame. Then remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Legendary Game of Sabacc
cards.flavor: Your skill at sabacc is well known throughout the galaxy, but another win could make you legendary. Especially if the odds are stacked against you.
cards.encounter: Choose another player in your space, and you resolve card #40.
cards.reward: Gain {CREDITS}10,000. If the active player claims this reward, they also gain 1 fame and discard this card.

cards.name: Undercover Agent
abilities: Action: If a player in your space has more fame than you, discard this card to gain 1 fame and make that player lose 1 reputation of your choice.

cards.name: Mandalorian Armor
text: When you gain the reward from a bounty, you may reduce the bounty's credit reward to {CREDITS}0 to gain 1 additional fame.

cards.name: Dejarik Holotable
text: While you have 2 or more crew, you have 1 additional fame.
abilities: Action: If you are at a navpoint, roll 1 die for each crew you have. For each {HIT} or {FOCUS} result, gain {CREDITS}1,000.
